description: Source file containing unit tests for the DeepLinkAgentPolicy component, validating message handling, delivery logic, and interactions with AgentDeepLink objects within the OpenClaw framework.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPolicyTests
classes.description: Test suite for validating DeepLinkAgentPolicy behaviors, including message validation and delivery rules.

methods.name: validate message for handle rejects too long when unkeyed
methods.description: Tests that excessively long messages are rejected when the link is not key-based.

methods.name: validate message for handle allows too long when keyed
methods.description: Ensures that long messages are accepted when the link is key-based (allowUnattended = true).

methods.name: effective delivery ignores delivery fields when unkeyed
methods.description: Verifies that certain delivery fields are ignored for unkeyed links and default to safe values.

methods.name: effective delivery honors deliver for deliverable channels when keyed
methods.description: Checks that delivery flags and channel are correctly respected when a key is provided.

methods.name: effective delivery still blocks web chat delivery when keyed
methods.description: Validates that web chat delivery is blocked even if delivery is enabled, when the link is keyed.
